questions.question: <div style=\"text-align:justify\">Let f(x) be a cubic polynomial which has local maximum at x = –1 and f'(x) has a local minimum at x = 1. If f(–1) = 10 and f(3) = –22, then find the distance between its two horizontal tangents.<\/div>$\n$
questions.explanation:
$ $ **Explain Question: Determine the vertical distance between two horizontal tangents (local maximum and local minimum values) of a specific cubic polynomial.
$ $**Concept: Properties of Cubic Polynomials, Relation between f(x) and f'(x), and Local Extrema.
$ $**Solution:
$ f$'(x) has a local minimum at x = 1
$ Let$ f''(x) = 6a (x – 1), (a ≠ 0 $\u$2235 cubic)
$ $⇒ = 3a (x2 – 2x) + b
$ $ ⇒ 9a + b = 0
$ $⇒ b = – 9a
$ $∴
$ $ ⇒ x = – 1, x = 3
$ $∴ y = f(–1) & y = f(3) are two horizontal tangents.
$ Distance$ b/w horizontal tangents = |f(–1) – f(3)|
$ $= (10 – (– 22)) = 32
$ $**Final answer : (32)
